test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion logically follows(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No astronaut is tall.

some tall are blue.

**Conclusions:**

I. some astronauts are blue.

II. No tall is an astronaut.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ee3dac69624520373d0cda2e3b5814a5b10736c81dfa12894e75afebf83d86e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. some astronauts are blue → False (No astronaut is tall and some tall are blue so, some astronauts are blue is false)

II. No tall is an astronaut → True (No astronaut is tall so, No tall is an astronaut is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
